title: Reconcile and fix cross-deployment metering offsets causing customer billing variance
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Summary: Multiple enterprise customers reported token/billing mismatches following a regional failover and a dedicated-to-hosted routing event. Discrepancies ranged from small (<2%) to large (>15%) depending on deployment mode. Investigation shows the metrics ingestion path and the tokenization library produced divergent token counts for the same request shape under retry/streaming conditions. This ticket coordinates the triage, hotfix, and reconciliation for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments and captures the mitigation and follow-ups.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use the customer test harness (conftest tokenized prompts) to send repeated streaming generate calls with network flaps simulated (30-200ms intermittent packet loss).
2) Trigger a retry path in the edge gateway by forcing a 504 on first POST, then allow retry to succeed while backend also processed original request (race).

3) Observe metrics in metrics-redwood.grafana: usage_ingest_events, tokens_counted_per_request, billing_aggregator_deltas. Note: observed duplicate event signatures and off-by-one token rounding in streaming responses.
4) Compare logs from Hosted / Dedicated / Private by request_id, idempotency_key, and kv_cache_key to see non-idempotent ingestion and differing rounding behavior.
investigation_log: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Pager alert: Finance spikes in invoice reconciliation for multiple enterprise accounts. Oncall: J. Lee. Notified billing-eng and runtime teams.
2026-03-10 11:40 - Initial triage call with SRE, Billing, Runtime, and Customer Success. Customer reported: NovaAnalytics saw +12% token delta after regional failover in eu-west-1.
2026-03-10 14:05 - Captured sample request IDs and aligned them across Hosted/Dedicated/Private logs. Noticed same request_id present twice in usage-ingest stream with different token_count values.
2026-03-11 08:30 - Localized root suspects: gateway retry semantics (edge), ingest dedupe logic (usage-collector), and streaming tokenization rounding (stream-tokenizer v1.6.0).
2026-03-11 13:20 - Reproduced locally with failure-injection harness. Confirmed race: edge retry + async ack pattern led to two ingestion events for same logical request when idempotency_key missing.

2026-03-12 16:00 - Short-term mitigation deployed to Hosted (edge): require idempotency_key OR enforce single-attempt-on-timeout for 60s window. Observed reduction in duplicate events in staging metrics.

2026-03-13 09:00 - Implemented dedupe by deterministic request fingerprint in billing-aggregator (draft PR). Still outstanding: streaming token rounding mismatch between tokenizer-lib in runtime and billing tokenization shim.
2026-03-14 10:25 - PRs opened for production hotfixes and tokenizer alignment. Finance requested a customer reconciliation plan; Customer Success preparing credit proposal for affected accounts.
root_cause: Composite issue: (A) Edge gateway retry semantics allowed duplicate backend processing when idempotency keys were absent for certain SDK versions; (B) usage-collector performed non-atomic updates to intermediate counters enabling double-counting during concurrent writes; (C) streaming tokenizer and billing tokenization used slightly different tokenization thresholds/rounding (v1.6.0 vs billing-shim v1.5.8), producing off-by-one differences later aggregated into noticeable invoice deltas.
mitigation: Short-term: 1) Enforce idempotency_key presence at edge for all generation requests and add 60s single-attempt gate for retrying SDK versions 2.x; 2) Apply a dedupe window in ingest pipeline (Kafka consumer level) to drop duplicate fingerprints; 3) Issue immediate customer credits for verified deltas >5% while fix lands. Long-term: align tokenizer implementations, add atomic increment semantics to usage-collector (redis lua or DB upsert), and add E2E regression tests for retry+streaming paths.
code_changes: usage-collector: add deterministic request fingerprint dedupe and atomic upsert counters
billing-aggregator: change to idempotent delta application and windowed replay protection
ingest-proxy/edge: require idempotency_key; gate retry path for older SDKs
tokenizer-lib: bump to unified tokenization algorithm and release runtime+billing-shim parity
next_steps: Merge PRs and schedule staged rollout to Hosted first, then Dedicated, then Private images per upgrade policy.
Run intra-team verification: end-to-end tests simulating retry/streaming under concurrency; target 0 duplicates in 1M requests.
Coordinate with Customer Success & Finance to finalize credits for affected accounts and publish summary to customers.
Add regression tests to CI that cover: sdk retry behavior, streaming tokenization parity, and billing-aggregator dedupe window behavior.
Postmortem and permanent monitoring: add alert for tokens_delta_percent > 1% correlated with regional failover or upgrade events.
